rules.title: C++ installer TUI cannot compile: build tools (g++/cmake) missing

fix.text: Arch: install the base-devel group (g++, make, cmake and friends).
fix.warning: Uses sudo; review the package list before confirming.

fix.text: Fedora: install the C++ toolchain and CMake.
fix.command: sudo dnf install gcc-c++ cmake make

fix.text: Debian/Ubuntu: install build-essential and CMake.
Re-run the installer afterwards: bash scripts/setup.sh (it resumes from where it stopped).

rules.title: Installer died with [FATAL] Failed to build the Caelestia installer — read the build log first

allOf.pattern: \[FATAL\] Failed to build the Caelestia installer

fix.text: Read the full build log — the real compiler error is in there, not in the TUI line.
If the log shows an old compiler, check the version (GCC 10+ required, C++20 project).
After fixing the root cause, re-run setup: bash scripts/setup.sh

rules.title: Shell build missing QML module metadata (Caelestia/Config qmldir not deployed)

fix.text: This is a stale/partial build artifact problem. Rebuild the shell from a clean tree.
fix.warning: Deletes the two build directories (regenerated by the next build). Your configs are not touched.
fix.undo: Not needed: build dirs are regenerated.

fix.text: Verify the plugin landed in the expected QML import path before starting the shell.

rules.title: Line ending normalization step failed (CRLF in scripts)

fix.text: Install dos2unix so the step can fix the files, then re-run setup.
Or answer 'n' when the installer offers to skip normalization; the rest of the install can proceed.

rules.title: pacman refuses to sync: invalid package signature from a mirror (keyring/mirror problem)

allOf.pattern: failed to synchronize all databases|error: failed to commit transaction

fix.text: Fix the keyring/mirror first, exactly as your distro documents it. On CachyOS/Arch this is usually the keyring, not this repo.
fix.warning: Uses sudo; adjust the keyring package names to your distro before running.

fix.text: Then refresh databases and only then re-run the installer — the maintainer's guidance in the thread was: fix signatures first, then rerun setup.
fix.warning: This performs a full system upgrade; review the package list.

fix.text: Re-run: bash scripts/setup.sh

rules.title: matugen is not installed — color generation cannot run

fix.text: Arch: matugen is in the extra repository.
Fedora: install via cargo (no distro package).

rules.title: src/dots submodule is empty — installer cannot deploy dotfiles

fix.text: Clone the upstream caelestia dotfiles into the submodule path.
Then re-run the submodule deploy step.
In a VM with a read-only shared folder (e.g. /mnt/hgfs), move the checkout to a real filesystem first; the docs call this out as a known trap.
Behind a proxy, export http_proxy/https_proxy before re-running so git can fetch.

rules.title: Upgrade replaced packages the running session still has in memory (logout/login or reboot needed)

allOf.pattern: The upgrade replaced packages the running session still has loaded in memory

fix.text: The upgrade already applied; nothing is re-downloaded. Save your work.
Log out and back in (or reboot) so the session loads the new libraries, then re-run the installer/update.

rules.title: Installer/update refuses to start: stale caelestia setup/update lock file

fix.text: First confirm no installer/update process is actually alive (use Ctrl+C to stop one politely, not SIGKILL).
Only if nothing shows up, remove the stale lock.
fix.warning: Never remove the lock while an install is genuinely running.

rules.title: Updater appears stuck cloning the repo — reset its local clone

fix.text: Wait first — slow mirrors make the clone look hung; the docs recommend waiting before assuming stuck.
If it truly is stuck, delete the updater's local clone; it re-clones on the next run.
fix.warning: Removes the updater's git clone (re-fetched automatically). Your shell settings are not stored here.
